subject: [hw] V02 start + core routing table (mask/match -> class), please check your space
body:
V02 (interpreter core: mem, dispatch, IT, run/call, host calls, faults) is implementing under gpu/hwcodec/emu/. Own: n2a32_core.c, n2a32_mem.c, n2a32_excl.c, n2a32_stub_classes.c, build.mk, test_v02/**. Proposed routing (checked against llvm-mc encodings of one example per family; class owners: tell me if your space is wrong).

A32, cond != 0xF, first match wins:
1 (i&0x0F000000)==0x0F000000                      SVC -> arm_misc
2 (i&0x0E000000)==0x0E000000 (b27-25=111)         MCR/MRC/CDP: cp=(i>>8)&15; cp10/11 -> vfp, else -> arm_misc
3 (i&0x0E000000)==0x0C000000 (110)                coproc load/store: cp10/11 -> vfp, else -> arm_misc
4 (i&0x0E000000)==0x0A000000 (101)                B/BL -> arm_misc
5 (i&0x0E000000)==0x08000000 (100)                LDM/STM -> arm_mem
6 (i&0x0E000000)==0x06000000 (011):
   b24==0                                         media -> arm_media
   b24==1 && b7-4==1                              media mul/div (SDIV/SMLAD/USAD8/...) -> arm_media
   (i&0x0FF000F0)==0x07F000F0                     UDF -> arm_misc
   b24==1 otherwise                               LDR/STR register -> arm_mem
7 (i&0x0E000000)==0x04000000 (010)                LDR/STR/LDRB/STRB imm -> arm_mem
8 (i&0x0E000000)==0x02000000 (001):
   (i&0x0FFF00FF)==0x03200000                     NOP/YIELD/WFE/WFI/SEV/SEVL -> arm_misc
   else                                           dp immediate incl. MOVW/MOVT/MSR imm -> arm_dp
9 (i&0x0E000000)==0x00000000 (000):
   b24==1 && b23-20>=8                            extra ld/st, LDREX/STREX/LDRD/STRD/LDRH... -> arm_mem
   b24==1 && b7-4==5                              QADD/QSUB/QDADD/QDSUB -> arm_media
   b24==1 && b7-4 in {8,10,12,14}                 SMLAxy/SMULxy/SMLAWy/SMULWy/SMLALxy -> arm_media
   b24==1 && (i&0x0FF000F0)==0x01200070           BKPT -> arm_misc
   b24==1 && b23-20==2 && b19-16==15 && b11-8==15 && b7-4 in {1,3}  BX/BLX(reg) -> arm_misc
   else                                           dp register/multiply/MRS/MSR/CLZ -> arm_dp

A32 cond == 0xF, by top byte:
 F0/F1                                            CPS/SETEND/unconditional misc -> arm_misc
 F2/F3  NEON data processing:
   b23==0                                          neon_3same (V18)
   op5=(i>>19)&31:
     op5==0x10 && b4 && (i&0x60)                   neon_misc (V20) [one-reg modified immediate]
     op5<=0x15                                     neon_shift (V19) [2reg+shift, 3 regs different lengths, 2reg+scalar, VMOVL]
     else                                          neon_misc (V20) [two regs misc: VEXT/VTBL/VDUP/VREV/...]
 F4   (i&0xFFF0F000)==0xF4D0F000                   PLI imm -> arm_mem
      else                                         NEON structure ld/st -> neon_ldst (V20)
 F5   (i&0xFFF0F000)==0xF5D0F000                   PLD/PLDW imm -> arm_mem
      (i&0xFFFFFFF0)==0xF57FF000                   DMB/DSB/ISB/CLREX -> arm_misc
      else                                         arm_misc
 F6/F7 (i&0xFFF00FF0)==0xF6D00000 / 0xF7D00000     PLI/PLD reg -> arm_mem; else arm_misc
 F8-FB                                            BLX imm (FA/FB) / unconditional -> arm_misc
 FC/FD  cp10/11 -> vfp else arm_misc               LDC2/STC2
 FE     cp10/11 -> vfp else arm_misc               CDP2/MCR2/MRC2 (ARMv8 VFP VMAXNM/VRINT/VCVTA live here)
 FF                                                SVC -> arm_misc

T32 (hw1 = first halfword; hw1 >= 0xE800 means a 32-bit instruction):
 0xE800-0xE9FF                                    t32_mem (LDM/STM, LDRD/STRD, LDREX/STREX, TBB/TBH)
 0xEA00-0xEBFF                                    t32_dp (shifted/extended register, PKH)
 0xEC00-0xEEFF                                    coprocessor: cp10/11 -> vfp, else t32_misc
 0xEF00-0xEFFF                                    NEON dp U=0: a32 = 0xF2000000 | (i & 0xFFFFFF) | ((i & 0x10000000) >> 4), then the F2/F3 split above
 0xF000-0xF7FF  hw2 bit15==1                      t32_misc (B/BL/BLX/B<c>, MRS/MSR, hints, barriers, UDF)
                hw2 bit15==0                      t32_dp (modified/plain immediate, MOVW/MOVT, bitfield, SSAT/USAT)
 0xF800-0xF9FF  bit20==1                          t32_mem (load/store single, PLD/PLI)
                bit20==0                          neon_ldst (V20; T32 word passed unchanged, F9xx)
 0xFA00-0xFBFF                                    t32_dp (data-processing register, MUL/MLA/MLS/SDIV/UDIV/SMULL/...)
 0xFC00-0xFDFF                                    coprocessor: cp10/11 -> vfp, else t32_misc
 0xFE00-0xFEFF                                    vfp (cp10/11; T32 word passed unchanged)
 0xFF00-0xFFFF                                    NEON dp U=1: a32 = 0xF3000000 | (i & 0xFFFFFF)
 all other 16-bit                                 t16

Header notes for hw-lead: (a) n2a32.h says T32 VFP words are passed "with the top nibble forced to 0xE"; T32 VFP VMAXNM/VRINT/VCVTA (ARMv8) are FE80.. and A32 uses FE too, so forcing E would corrupt them. I pass VFP words unchanged (they are identical in both sets), and I will only force 0xE if you confirm otherwise. (b) T32 NEON VLD1/VST1 words are F9xx while A32 is F4xx with identical low 24 bits; per the header I pass the T32 word unchanged to neon_ldst (V20), i.e. V20 must accept F9xx as the T32 form. (c) c->in_it: I set it when ITSTATE<3:0> != 0; the core performs ITAdvance after every T32 instruction that was in a block, skipped ones included, and clears ITSTATE on switching to ARM.

Questions welcome; I will post test commands and results when done.
